headline: A useful repair. Flywheel superiority remains on hold.

findings.label: MISSION A · DEVELOPMENT
findings.note: 72.202 → 11.562 ms median total CPU; 39 → 4 Git processes. All 37 source files remained byte-exact across five repeats per method. Comparison: original call site.

findings.label: FRESH MISSION B · DEVELOPMENT
findings.note: 1.510538 → 0.172914 s median total CPU; 876 → 6 Git processes. All three rendered workers remained byte-exact. The reader was selected on A before B; all 30 development runs passed.

findings.label: PROTECTED CONFIRMATION · CORRECTNESS
findings.note: Every evaluated read or diagnostic output passed. One frozen campaign: 24 generated repository instances × 7 arms × 8 repeated operations. The statistical unit is the repository instance.

findings.label: PRIMARY TEST · STRONGEST ALTERNATIVE
findings.note: Flywheel / direct specialist total CPU ratio; 95% interval [1.0246, 1.0899]. The flywheel used about 5.74% more CPU. Admission: retain the strongest direct specialist.

findings.label: EXECUTED CAPABILITY LINEAGE
findings.note: The selected parent ran in 24 cases × 4 diagnostic repeats. One distinct authored child template produced 24 scoped bindings. This establishes executed reuse, not 24 new inventions.

findings.label: FULL INVESTMENT · PAYBACK
findings.note: Model, human, integration and maintenance costs remain incomplete. Complete research payback, monetary profit and acceleration are unproved. No external executor or live settlement was used.

limits: These are recorded Python/Git research results. The live UTF-8 browser example above uses its own fixed instrument and is not this benchmark or protected confirmation.
The campaign used one host, one public source ecosystem and 24 generated instances, not 24 natural repositories. Confidence intervals are conditional on that source pool, generator and host.
One fresh Python process and three warm in-process calls were recorded. The shared operating-system cache was not flushed; no physical disk-cold performance is claimed.
Construction used bounded, preauthored deterministic templates. Superiority of an autonomous language-model agent was not tested; useful batching is an established specialist technique.

Correctness and actual parent use passed. The predeclared performance gate did not pass, so the stronger flywheel-specific claim remains on hold. The bounded campaign stopped without tuning for a favorable confirmation result.
